name: waterproofing-floorlevels-bsj78
description: BSJ-7/8 visual verification: (a) the dimensioned plan sheet with waterproofing hatch + zone-derived FFL tags + a doorway step marker + legend (captured drawing-set HTML injected + scrolled to the Dimensioned plan sheet); (b) the room inspector Floor level field in the plan editor. Runs in Pro (both flags are pro-tier).

steps.name: seed-floor-levels
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); const rooms=s.floorPlan.rooms; const isBath=(r)=>r.category==='bath'||r.category==='powder'||/bath|toilet|\bwc\b/i.test(r.name); const baths=rooms.filter(isBath); if(!baths.length) throw new Error('no bath room in default flat'); s.updateRoom(baths[0].id,{floorLevelMm:-50}); if(baths[1]) s.updateRoom(baths[1].id,{floorLevelMm:-25}); window.__bathId=baths[0].id; window.__bathName=baths[0].name; })()

steps.name: patch-window-open
steps.eval: window.__capturedHtml=null; window.__origWindowOpen=window.open; window.open=function(){ return { document:{ write:function(html){ window.__capturedHtml=html }, close:function(){} }, close:function(){}, focus:function(){}, print:function(){} }; };

steps.name: click-drawing-set
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn=[...document.querySelectorAll('.pop-panel button')].find(b=>/Drawing set/.test(b.textContent||'')); if(!btn) throw new Error('Drawing set button not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: wait-html-captured
steps.failMessage: openDrawingSet() never wrote HTML via the intercepted window.open

steps.name: assert-overlay-content
steps.eval: (function(){ const h=window.__capturedHtml; for (const needle of ['Waterproofing zone','FFL','step + transition strip']) { if(!h.includes(needle)) throw new Error('drawing-set HTML missing: '+needle); } })()

steps.name: scroll-to-dimensioned-plan
steps.eval: (function(){ const g=document.querySelector('.wp-levels-overlay'); if(!g) throw new Error('waterproofing/levels overlay not found in injected HTML'); const svg=g.closest('svg')||g; svg.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); })()
